examples.arabic: مع غروب شمس ذلك اليوم العاصف، كانوا متعبين ولكنهم يشعرون بالرضا الداخلي بعد إنجازهم الجماعي.
examples.english: As the sun set on that stormy day, they were tired but felt inner satisfaction after their collective achievement.
examples.transliteration: Ma' ghurub shams dhalika al-yawm al-'aasif, kanu mut'abeen walakin-hum yash'urun bil-rida ad-dakhili ba'da injaz-hum al-jama'i.

examples.arabic: وفعلاً، نتمنى إنه الشمس رح تشرق قريباً وتجفف الشوارع، عشان نطلع كلنا نعمل مشاويرنا اللي أجلناها.
examples.english: And indeed, we hope that the sun will shine soon and dry the streets, so we can all go out and do our errands that we postponed.
examples.transliteration: w fa'lan, nitmanna inno ash-shams rah tishroq qariban w tijaffif ash-shawari', 'ashan nitla' kullna ni'mil mashawirna illi ajjalnaha.
examples.storyTitle: Family Warmth in a Damascus Winter

examples.arabic: كانت شمس الصيف الحارقة قد بدأت ترسم لوحات ذهبية على أسطح بيوت الشام العتيقة، في تموز الذي لا يرحم.
examples.english: The scorching summer sun had begun to paint golden canvases on the rooftops of ancient Damascus houses, in an unforgiving July.
examples.transliteration: Kanat shams as-sayf al-hariqa qad badaat tarsum lawhat thahabiyya ala astuh buyut ash-Sham al-atiqa, fi Tammouz allathi la yarham.
examples.storyTitle: Damascus Summer and the Warmth of Hearts

examples.arabic: قعدت بالكافيه بستنى صاحبي وكان الجو حلو والشمس خفيفة
examples.english: I sat at the café waiting for my friend, and the weather was nice with mild sun.
examples.transliteration: Qa'adt bil-kafiyeh bastanna sahbi w kan al-jaww hilu w ash-shams khafifa.
